ex.en: Online courses have gained popularity among working adults.
ex.zh: 网络课程在职成年人中越来越受欢迎。

words.note: popularity 常搭 gain/lose popularity。

ex.en: His teammates nicknamed him Tiger because of his speed.
ex.zh: 队友因他速度快，给他起了个绰号叫“老虎”。

words.note: nickname 可作动词，用 nickname sb sth。

ex.en: The first meeting was brief, and subsequent discussions lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 第一次会面很简短，随后的讨论持续了数小时。

words.note: subsequent 后接 to，副词 subsequently。

ex.en: Regular exercise can raise your metabolic rate and help control weight.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼能提高你的代谢率，有助于控制体重。

words.note: metabolic 名词是 metabolism，表代谢的。

ex.en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humanity today.
ex.zh: 气候变化是当今人类面临的最大挑战之一。

words.note: humanity 表人类不可数；the humanities 为人文学科。

ex.en: The company invests heavily in technological innovation to stay ahead.
ex.zh: 公司大力投资技术创新以保持领先。

words.note: innovation 可数指新事物，不可数指创新。

ex.en: Visitors are asked not to drop litter in the park.
ex.zh: 请游客不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。

words.note: litter 作动词指乱扔；英式 litter bin 即垃圾箱。

ex.en: The hotel charges extra for breakfast and internet access.
ex.zh: 酒店早餐和上网另收费。

words.note: charge sb for sth 收费；in charge of 表负责。

ex.en: She pressed the shutter just as the sun rose over the hills.
ex.zh: 太阳从山头升起时，她按下了快门。

words.note: shutter 指窗板，也指相机快门。

ex.en: The nurse alternates between day and night shifts every two weeks.
ex.zh: 这位护士每两周在日班和夜班之间轮换。

words.note: alternate 形容词重音在后，动词重音在前。

ex.en: She is writing a biography of the scientist who discovered penicillin.
ex.zh: 她正在写那位发现青霉素的科学家的传记。

words.note: biography 传记，autobiography 是自传。

ex.en: Staff must follow the safety procedure before entering the laboratory.
ex.zh: 员工进入实验室前必须遵守安全程序。

words.note: procedure 指固定步骤，process 强调过程。

ex.en: The doctor took a blood sample and sent it to the lab.
ex.zh: 医生取了血样，送到实验室。

words.note: sample 作动词可指抽样调查或品尝。

ex.en: Share prices plunged after the company announced its losses.
ex.zh: 公司公布亏损后，股价暴跌。

words.note: plunge 指突然下跌或跳入，常搭 into。

ex.en: Many economists remain skeptical about the accuracy of the forecast.
ex.zh: 许多经济学家仍对预测的准确性持怀疑态度。

words.note: 美式 skeptical，英式 sceptical，后接 about。

ex.en: Too much ultraviolet light can damage your skin and eyes.
ex.zh: 过多的紫外线会损伤皮肤和眼睛。

words.note: ultraviolet 缩写 UV，前缀 ultra- 表超出。

ex.en: Scientists are studying how planetary systems form around young stars.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究行星系统如何围绕年轻恒星形成。

words.note: planetary 由 planet 加 -ary 构成，指行星的。

ex.en: You need to apply for a visa at least a month before you travel.
ex.zh: 你至少要在出行前一个月申请签证。

words.note: visa 可数，常搭 apply for a visa。

ex.en: He was diagnosed with diabetes during a routine medical check.
ex.zh: 他在一次常规体检中被诊断出患有糖尿病。

words.note: diagnose 常搭 be diagnosed with。

ex.en: More than ten thousand residents signed the petition against the new road.
ex.zh: 一万多名居民签署了反对修建新路的请愿书。

words.note: petition 可作动词，petition sb for sth。

ex.en: There are no hotels in the vicinity of the airport.
ex.zh: 机场附近没有旅馆。

words.note: vicinity 常用 in the vicinity of。

ex.en: It would be naive to expect quick results from such a reform.
ex.zh: 指望这样的改革迅速见效未免太天真。

words.note: naive 指轻信幼稚，childlike 指天真可爱。

ex.en: Clean water is essential to public health in every country.
ex.zh: 清洁的水对每个国家的公共卫生都必不可少。

words.note: essential 后接 to/for；essentials 指必需品。

ex.en: The government plans to increase expenditure on education next year.
ex.zh: 政府计划明年增加教育支出。

words.note: expenditure 常与 on 连用，表某方面支出。

ex.en: He vented his anger on the staff when the plan failed.
ex.zh: 计划失败后，他把怒气发泄在员工身上。

words.note: vent 作动词常搭 on，如 vent anger on sb。

ex.en: She was haunted by memories of the accident for years.
ex.zh: 那起事故的回忆多年来一直缠绕着她。

words.note: haunt 指鬼魂出没，也指记忆萦绕心头。

ex.en: A short silence preceded his answer, which made everyone nervous.
ex.zh: 他回答前短暂沉默，让大家有些不安。

words.note: precede 是动词，precedent 是名词先例。

ex.en: The audience gasped in surprise when the magician disappeared.
ex.zh: 魔术师消失时，观众惊讶得倒抽一口气。

words.note: gasp for breath 指急促呼吸；名词 gasp。

ex.en: They took a leisurely stroll along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后他们沿河悠闲散步。

words.note: stroll 指悠闲散步，比 walk 更显轻松。

ex.en: The flat is furnished with a bed, a desk and two chairs.
ex.zh: 这套公寓配有床、书桌和两把椅子。

words.note: furnish sb with sth 表提供；furnished 带家具。
